name: Fritzlar (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided blue over white, charged at the centre with the city arms of Fritzlar (two red wheels joined by a cross on white).
history: Municipal flag of Fritzlar; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Fritzlar arms — two red wheels on white
